summary.en: Ebola has expanded to an eighth province in the DRC, prompting heightened alerts in Lubumbashi and calls for border closures. Kenyan and other long-distance truck drivers suspended DRC-bound cargo after 12 drivers were killed, leading Kenya to halt operations and Uganda to close its border over Ebola fears. Rebel groups including the FRN near Lubumbashi and the ADF in Ituri continued attacks that killed civilians and threatened regional security. The African Union is urging cease-fire compliance and inclusive dialogue. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Ebola har spredd seg til en åttende provins i DRC, noe som har ført til skjerpede varsler i Lubumbashi og krav om grenselukking. Kenyanske og andre langdistanselastebilsjåfører stoppet last til DRC etter at 12 sjåfører ble drept, noe som førte til at Kenya stanset operasjonene og Uganda lukket grensen på grunn av ebolafrykt. Opprørsgrupper inkludert FRN nær Lubumbashi og ADF i Ituri fortsatte angrep som drepte sivile og truet regional sikkerhet. Den afrikanske unionen oppfordrer til overholdelse av våpenhvile og inkluderende dialog. Konflikten forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
